messages:
mira_sales: Heads-up — Prospect 'Pangea' started a short POC and ran a burst test. They're seeing high first-byte times (1.6s baseline, up to ~3.2s under ramp) and occasional 429s. They also want a firm per-token estimate for the POC and sent the security questionnaire. Can we triage?

ashley_se: Copy. Can you share a sample request/response and the load pattern? Need to know concurrency and avg prompt length.

mira_sales: They ran 40 concurrent workers, each sending ~60-120 token prompts every 300ms. Sample curl (local):

mira_sales: ```bash
$ time curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-TEST" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-3b","input":"Explain...","max_tokens":128}'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Redwood-Request-ID: req_02G...

real    0m1.62s
user    0m0.01s
sys     0m0.01s
```

mira_sales: Dashboard screenshots show 429s with bursty ramp and queue depths increasing briefly.

devon_ml: Repro'd similar pattern in staging with same QPS and variable sequence lengths. Two likely contributors: (A) request-level fanout causing poor batching characteristics (many small, parallel requests), (B) low KV/prefix cache hit rate because POC uses varied system messages + code samples.

ashley_se: Are they on Hosted or did they request Dedicated?

mira_sales: Hosted trial keys. They asked about Dedicated pricing for the POC to get predictable latency.

jordan_sales: For pricing, we can propose a short reserved slab (1-2 GPUs equivalent) for 10 business days with a POC credit to cover baseline. Overage billed at negotiated per-token. I'll prepare a one-pager.

security_eng: On the questionnaire: they asked about key management and audit logs. For Hosted we can provide SOC2 summary and describe our KMS integration for disk/envelope encryption. For customer-managed KMS and isolated audit logs we recommend Redwood Private (VPC) POC. I can anonymize the relevant sections and share.

devon_ml: Measured KV hit-rate in the repro was ~18%. When that happens our per-request latency includes an extra ~700-1100ms due to larger memory loads + kernel/path warmups. Also batching: by default the router tries to maximize throughput; under heavy parallelism that can push up tail latency.

devon_ml: Quick mitigations we can push on Hosted without infra changes:
- decrease max_batch_latency (so router flushes smaller batches faster)
- set routing_policy: low_latency for their API key
- enable prefix prewarm for the test session
Example config snippet:```yaml
api_key_configs:
  pangea_poc_key:
    routing_policy: low_latency
    batching:
      max_batch_size: 6
      max_batch_latency_ms: 10
    cache:
      prefix_prewarm: true
      kv_retention_minutes: 60
```

tom_ops: Also recommend client changes: reduce concurrent open connections (use a small connection pool), add exponential backoff on 429s (start 50-100ms), and coalesce short prompts where possible. If they can move static system/context into a cached prefix that helps hit-rate.

mira_sales: I'll ask them to try a paced run (pool size 8, request spacing 200ms) and re-run the ramp. I'll send the client sample code.

jordan_sales: I'll attach a POC pricing option: 2-week reserved capacity + $X credit + overage rate Y. Need finance signoff but want to show them numbers quickly.

ashley_se: Can we offer a one-week Dedicated evaluation for them? Even a small reserved instance removes multi-tenant jitter and proves steady latency.

tom_ops: Small Dedicated trial is doable for sales-led POCs — coordinate with infra provisioning. I'll queue a provisioning ticket once you confirm dates.

deploy-bot: Notice: no ongoing platform incidents affecting inference clusters.

devon_ml: Additional note: their prompts include long triple-backtick code blocks causing sequence length variance; that increases batch skew. If they can detect and compress/trim those before send, batching improves. Also moving repeated system content to the prefix dramatically raised KV hit-rate in my tests (~80% -> 85% after).

mira_sales: Action list: (1) Send client pacing example and ask for new logs, (2) propose Dedicated trial + draft pricing blurb, (3) forward security questions to security_eng for answers and a checklist, (4) request dates if they want the Dedicated evaluation.

security_eng: I'll prepare an FAQ snippet for the questionnaire focusing on KMS, key rotation, audit log retention, and SOC2 controls — can tag legal if they want more detail.

ashley_se: I'll put together a one-pager runbook for the customer: how to measure TTFT, how to run a controlled ramp, and the config toggles we suggested.

jordan_sales: Draft pricing doc sent to ashley for review. Will loop in finance and ops once you confirm the Dedicated window.

mira_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll post their paced-test results here when available. :thumbsup:
